translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Debida ivigakaisi guyoula Yuda

E yam oluvi, Debida ikatupoi Guyau, kawala, “Mwa! Kudoki gagabila bala akaraiwogi avai valu mapilana Yuda?” Guyau ivitakauloki, kawala, “E bwaina wala.” E Debida ikatupoivau kawala, “Ki avai valuga?” Guyau ikaibiga, kawala, “Ebironi.”
Mapaila Debida ilokaia Ebironi, e matauna ivakouli nayu la kukova ilosi deli. Minasina goli Ainowam minana vilela Yesireeli, deli Abigeili minana kubuyala Nabali metoya Kamela.
E deli goli matauna ivakouli mimilisi la tokwabilia deli litusia, e imili valusi mavilousina viluwela Ebironi.
Oluvi mina Yuda leimaisi Ebironi e ibulamaisi Debida paila guyoula Yuda. E avai tuta Debida bogwa leilagi mina Yabesi bogwa leibakwaisi Saulo mapilana Giliadi,
matauna iwitali mimilisi tomota ilauwaisi la biga kawala, “Ibodi Guyau bikabwailimi, paila bogwa lokubakwaisi mi guyau e makawala lokukimitalaisi mi kamaiaba paila matauna.
Mapaila tuta baisa ibodi Guyau bikimidagi la mitakwai baisa yokomi. Deli goli yeigu bamitukwaiyaimi bwaina paila baisa avaka bogwa lokuvagaisi.
E mapaila bukupapeulasi deli bukutuvaluwasi! Paila Saulo mi guyau bogwa leikaliga, e matausina mina Yuda bogwa leibulamaigusi paila si guyau.”
Isiboseti iguyoi mapilana Isireli
E Saulo la kumatoula yagala Abina matauna Nera latula, kasitaiyu Isiboseti matauna Saulo latula isakaulasi iluvapeilisi Waya Yoridani ilosi Maanaim.
Metoya mapilana, Abina ivigaki Isiboseti iguyoi valu mapilasina, Giliadi, Asera, Yesireeli, Beniamina, Epereim deli komwaidona Isireli goli.
Matauna kala taitu iboda kwailuwovasi eivitouula eiguyau olopola Isireli, e matauna iguguyau iboda kwaiyu taitu.
Mitaga Yuda dalela ikamiabaisi wala Debida, e matauna iguguyau Ebironi mapilana Yuda iboda kwailima kwaiyu taitu kabulotala.
Kabilia oluwalaisi Isireli deli Yuda
E Abina deli Isiboseti la kumatoula metoyasi ovalu Maanaim ilosi ovalu Gibioni.
E Yowabi inala Seruya, e matausina Debida la kumatoula ibodaisi matausina okatuwotu, e baisa komwaidosi isilaisi, budotala katuwotu pilatala, e buduyuwela pilayuwela.
E Abina iluki Yowabi kawala, “Ibodi kaina bitatugwalaisi budoyu tubovau metoya oda bodasi biyowaisi metoya osi kaiyala.” Yowabi ivitakaula kawala, “Bogwa bwaina.”
Mapaila tailuwotala taiyu matausina tokabilia simatila Isiboseti deli Beniamina dalela, iyowaiyaisi tailuwotala taiyu Debida la tokabilia.

E taitala taitala igudu kulula sola e ibasi kaiyala ovisiala mapaila komwaidosi matausina tailuwoyu taivasi ikapusisi wala gulitinidesi ikaligasi. E mapaila olumoulela Gibioni valu mapilana idokaisi yagala “Bikubakula vilougaga”.
Oluvi kabilia saina wala iyouloveka, e Debida la tomota itomgwagasi odubasi Abina deli mina Isireli.
E minana Seruya litula kasitaitolu deli wala isisuaisi, matausina Yowabi, Abisai, deli Asaeli. E Asaeli matauna bisakaula saina gigibula makawala natana diya nabolodila,
e ivitouula ibokavili Abina, isisakaula ibubwakavila wala matauna.
E Abina imitavila e ikaibiga kawala, “Ki, Asaeli yokula?” Matauna ivitakauloki kawala, “Mayeigula.”
Abina ikaibiga kawala, “Desi taga kubokavilaigu! Kubokavili taitala matausina tokabilia e kulebu avaka iyosi.” Mitaga Asaeli ibokavili wala matauna.
Tuvaila Abina iluki matauna kawala, “Mwa desi taga kubokavilaigu! Avaka paila kukwaliyeiya magim bukukwatumataigu? Ka, kidamwa bakatumataim, ammakawala batovilaki tuwam Yowabi?”

Mitaga Asaeli gala wala ilagi biga. Mapaila Abina, ikaluyumali wala la kaiyala, ibasi matauna olopola e kaiyala ila isunapula otapwala. Asaeli ikapusi opwaipwaia ikaliga, e komwaidosi availa matausina leimaisi makatupona ambaisa matauna leikanukwenu itowaisi wala baisa.
Mitaga Yowabi sola Abisai ibokulaisi Abina, e bogwa eisalala matala kalasia matausina imaisi wa koya Ama, mapilana opilibomatula Giya okedala biloula Gibioni oviloupakala.
E dalela Beniamina itoulaisi itopataisi Abina tuvaila e itotusi odubiliwotala koya.

E Abina ikawota ilukwaiwa Yowabi kawala, “Ki bwaina wala bitayayosasi kabilia ke? Ki gala kunikoli paila avai tuta biwokuva kabilia gala wala avai vavagi bikaloubusi mesinaku wala ninigaga? Yakamaisi veimia wala. Ki ammakawala kala kaduwonaku bikau oluviga bukukwaraiwogi m tokabila bisimwaisi bwakavila?”
Yowabi imapu kawala, “Alivala biga katotila mwau omatala Guyau Tomomova, kidamwa gala bukulivala baisa, ulo tokabilia bibokavilaimi wala tatoula nabwaia kaukwau.”
Mapaila Yowabi iyuvi tauya kabotuvitusila la tokabilia gala tuvaila bibokavilaisi mina Isireli; e kabilia imata.
Bogi makwaina kwemwaidona Abina deli la tokabilia isuwalaiyaisi wala Yoridani Itayatila, matausina iluvapeilisi Waya Yoridani e kaukwau komwaidona ililoulasi ikaimilavausi ovalu Maanaim.
Avai tuta Yowabi isim bwakavila matausina, matauna ikoguguli la tokabilia gulitinidesi, e ibani tailuwotala tailima taivasi eitamwausi; Asaeli madeilila wala.
Debida la tokabilia leikatumataisi matausina kasi bawa lakatutolu tailuwolima tailuwotala Abina la tokabilia metoya odalela Beniamina.
Yowabi deli la tokabilia ikauwaisi Asaeli wowola ilauwaisi ibakwaisi okasi laka deli dalela mapilana Bedeliem. E bogi kwemwaidona matausina ililoulasi wala e eiyam kaukwau iviloubusisi Ebironi.
